people.name: Darius
people.line: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Shethar-bozenai
people.line: Persian official who questioned the Jews' temple rebuilding

people.name: Tattenai
people.line: Persian governor who questioned the Jews' authority to rebuild

translations.web: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites, who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows.
translations.bsb: This is the text of the letter that Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates, the officials in the region, sent to King Darius.
translations.kjv: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
